capabilities: Open the official SCVMBIRTHER generator in a browser
Parse copied generator page text from the clipboard
Create Markdown character notes with frontmatter, stat callout, and organized sections
Format selected text in an existing note as character Markdown
Configure a destination folder without overwriting existing notes
disambiguation: Not a character generator itself; it imports and formats characters generated on the SCVMBIRTHER website.
extras: Published under the MÖRK BORG Third Party License; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. All conversion happens locally with no API requests or telemetry.
problem: SCVMBIRTHER exposes no public API or Markdown export, so generated characters must be copied and restructured by hand to live in a campaign vault.

relations.evidence: Create polished MÖRK BORG-compatible character notes in Obsidian from characters generated by SCVMBIRTHER.
a tabletop role-playing game (TTRPG) plugin for importing generated MÖRK BORG characters

summary: Imports MÖRK BORG characters generated on the SCVMBIRTHER website into Obsidian as formatted Markdown notes with frontmatter and stat callouts.
